name: Asylum Eberek
description: In a remote place of Alkira Mountain, there is a powerful magical construction that receives visits from people across all Tanares. It is made of marble and gems, many of which have a pulsating shine. This asylum has a unique feature. When an individual is admitted to this place, others gradually forget about this person, taking up to an entire month for them to be fully forgotten. This means that anyone might have a family member there whom they have forgotten about. It is a very convenient place, as people can abandon members of their families without carrying the guilt of this action. In around one month, the creature starts to live in an illusion of life through a dream, varying in the time they experience. Freeing someone at this stage is almost impossible. Recently, the wizard Alina from the Council developed a powerful spell allowing a group to project into the Astral Plane, enter the individual’s dreams, and retrieve their consciousness by convincing them to wake up from the dream’s illusion. Some reports suggest these dreams can be extremely dangerous, as fears and hidden secrets may manifest to the group in various forms. If a person dies in the dream, their soul must be recovered first from there before any resurrection attempt can be made.
